name: Overclocked
desc: Engineered by P.A.C.K. technicians, this vessel's power grid has been pushed far beyond safe factory specifications. The intensive tuning yields superior combat performance but requires constant maintenance, increasing monthly supply maintenance cost by %s percent.
short: Increases performance and supply maintenance cost.

name: Overclocked
desc: Engineered by P.A.C.K. technicians, this vessel's power grid has been pushed far beyond safe factory specifications. The intensive tuning yields superior combat performance but requires constant maintenance, increasing monthly supply maintenance cost by %s percent.
short: Increases performance and supply maintenance cost.

name: Overclocked
desc: An aggressive variant of P.A.C.K. overclocking that strips away internal safety limiters. Increases monthly supply maintenance cost by %s percent, and the intense mechanical stress reduces peak combat readiness duration by %s percent.
short: Increases performance and maintenance, reduces peak CR duration.

name: Pre-militarized Hullform
desc: A poorly executed attempt to bring a civilian vessel up to military standards. Improvised bulkheads and unshielded engine blocks counteract the benefits of mil-spec armor coatings, increasing the ship's sensor profile by %s percent.
short: Increases ship sensor profile.

name: Bullseye Suite
desc: A comprehensive aftermarket overhaul of the vessel's reactor and targeting computers. Designed by P.A.C.K. engineers for prolonged warfare, this suite significantly improves flux handling and mobility systems.
short: Improves flux handling and mobility.
sModDesc: Increases projectile speed by %s and weapon turn rate by %s.

name: ASP Syndicate Sponsored
desc:
Maintained under a premium ASP Syndicate service contract. The hull gleams with a polished finish, and all internal systems are kept in immaculate condition.

Features a heavily augmented corporate flux grid that increases flux capacity by %s and reduces shield damage taken by %s, at the cost of reducing flux dissipation by %s.
short: Expands flux capacity and reduces shield damage taken, but reduces flux dissipation.

name: Integrated Point Defense AI
desc: An integrated AI routine that dynamically slaves small weapons to a localized defense grid, granting all small non-missile weapons the ability to automatically track and engage incoming enemy missiles.
short: All small non-missile weapons act as point-defense.

name: Metastable Drive Field
desc:
Conventional wisdom dictates that a metastable drive is perfectly safe, provided it isn't pushed too far.
At high hard flux levels, this scavenged drive field destabilizes to provide a significant speed boost (up to %s). This deliberate instability is prone to catastrophic overloads, but makes the vessel remarkably easy to recover after a battle.
short: Speed boost at high flux, dangerous overloads.
sModDesc: Reduces overload duration by %s and decreases EMP damage taken by %s.

name: Shocking Behaviour
desc: Due to dangerously exposed flux coils and improvised power conduits, this module arcs volatile electrical discharges back to its parent station at high flux levels.
short: Arcs electrical discharge to parent station at high flux.

name: Octopus No Shields
desc: Attempting to install secondary generators causes catastrophic phase interference. Shield hullmods are strictly prohibited, as the built-in dedicated shield module handles all protective shielding.
short: Prohibits shield hullmods due to external shield module.

name: Wibble Wobble
desc: A notorious side effect of Junk Pirate 'good enough' engineering. The gyroscopic stabilizers are slightly misaligned, causing the module to sway noticeably when under thrust.
short: Improvised gyroscopic stabilizers cause slight module sway.

name: Wobble Wibble
desc: A severe iteration of gyroscopic misalignment. The vessel's superstructure shudders violently under engine stress, causing erratic module sway during high-speed maneuvers.
short: Severe gyroscopic misalignment causes pronounced module sway.

name: Blue Zapper
desc: An experimental iteration of the metastable drive. It created a cascading wave of volatility that doomed several test crews. The project was abruptly canceled, but a few of these highly dangerous prototype drives remain in circulation.
short: Extreme speed boost at high flux, highly dangerous.

name: Born with a Silver Spanner
desc: The chaotic hierarchy of a Junk Pirate crew ensures the vessel remains operational long after warning klaxons have sounded. Their frantic, unconventional repairs result in %s higher maximum combat readiness and a %s reduction in CR degradation once peak time has expired.
short: Increases maximum combat readiness and reduces CR degradation rate.

name: Survival Instincts
desc: Operated by a P.A.C.K. crew utilizing proprietary, arcane communication protocols. The resulting high-bandwidth network allows for superior tactical responsiveness and a vastly reduced electronic footprint, lowering the vessel's sensor profile to %s of its base value.
short: Reduces ship sensor profile.

name: Corporate Discipline
desc: A tidy workspace yields a tidy profit. ASP Syndicate crews are renowned for their meticulous maintenance and strict organizational protocols. This professional upkeep results in a %s boost to overall combat readiness and a %s improvement in flux dissipation.
short: Increases maximum combat readiness and flux dissipation.

name: P.A.C.K. Mesh
desc:
The P.A.C.K. rely on a highly resilient, proprietary mesh network to coordinate deployments. When multiple ships utilizing this network are deployed together, they share processing power to boost the entire fleet.
Each unique hull class contributes its bonus once:
Frigate: +%s weapon range
Destroyer: -%s shield damage taken
Cruiser: +%s top speed
5+ unique hulls: -%s weapon flux cost
10+ unique hulls: +%s base flux capacity and dissipation
short: Fleet bonuses based on diverse P.A.C.K. hulls deployed.
sModDesc: Increases base top speed by %s and reduces weapon flux cost by %s.

name: Spinerette Base Fix
desc: Internal station module handling routine that manages target selection and refit priority for Spinerette station segments.
short: Internal station module priority controller.

name: Scrap Damper (Passive)
desc: Passive localized structural fields permanently reduce damage taken by armor, hull, and EMP by %s. When the ship's Scrap Damper system is active, this total reduction scales up to %s.
short: Passively reduces damage taken; boosted while Scrap Damper is active.

name: Heavy Interdiction Housing
desc: Hollowed-out internals limit maximum Combat Readiness by %s.
short: Reduces max CR to 85%%.
